<p>Besides JSON, XML, YAML and CSV, <b>{data}</b> reads the formats of
<code>pad/subs/formats/</code>: TOML, INI, TSV, NDJSON, Markdown pipe tables, iCalendar,
vCard, GeoJSON, GPX, WebVTT and SRT subtitles and Excel spreadsheets. Name the format with <code>format=</code> - or
<code>type=</code>, the same option:</p>

<p>An array of tables is a list of rows inside the row, so <code>{stops}</code>
iterates it; a date is the text it is, <code>2026-11-06</code>.</p>

<h2>Known on sight</h2>

<p>Some formats need no name: a text that opens with <code>BEGIN:VCALENDAR</code> is a
calendar, <code>BEGIN:VCARD</code> a vCard, lines of JSON objects NDJSON, a Markdown pipe
table a table and a header of tabs TSV. Each event is a row - <code>summary</code>,
<code>start</code>, <code>end</code>, <code>allday</code>, <code>location</code> and the rest:</p>

<h2>Captions and subtitles</h2>

<p>A text that opens with <code>WEBVTT</code> is the captions of a video, an SRT file its
subtitles: a cue is a row - <code>start</code> and <code>end</code> as
<code>00:01:02.500</code> (<code>startms</code> and <code>endms</code> in milliseconds),
<code>text</code> with its markup, <code>plain</code> without it and <code>voice</code>, who
speaks:</p>

<h2>Files and PHP</h2>

<p>A file in <code>_data/</code> is read by its extension - <code>_data/trip.toml</code> is
<code>{trip}</code> and <code>{local:trip.toml}</code>,
<code>_data/sales.xlsx</code> the first sheet of the workbook
(<code>{local:sales.xlsx sheet='Notes'}</code> another). In a page's PHP,
<code>padFormatRead</code> reads a text and <code>padFormatWrite</code> writes rows:</p>



 



   
    <table border="1" cellpadding="10" cellspacing="0" class="pad-play-box">
  

  

      
          <tr>
          
            <th bgcolor="#dddddd">
              PHP <br><font size="-2">fragments/data_formats_3.php</font>
            </th>
          
          
            <th bgcolor="#dddddd">
              HTML <br><font size="-2">fragments/data_formats_3.pad</font>
            </th>
          
          
            <th bgcolor="#dddddd">
              Result
            </th>
          
        </tr>
      

      <tr>
        
          <td style="vertical-align:top"><pre><code style="color: #000000"><span style="color: #0000BB">&lt;?php<br><br>  $readme </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #DD0000">"# Scores\n\nThe table is the data.\n\n| player | points |\n| ------ | -----: |\n| Ann    |     21 |\n| Bob    |     17 |\n"</span><span style="color: #007700">;<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$scores </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padFormatRead </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'markdown'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$readme </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$tsv    </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padFormatWrite </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'tsv'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$scores </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br><br></span><span style="color: #0000BB">?&gt;<br></span></code></pre> </td>
        
        
          <td style="vertical-align:top"><a class="pad-play" href="/pad/playground/#" title="Try it in the playground" aria-label="Try this example in the playground"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-play" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7Z"/></svg></a><a class="pad-play pad-live" href="/pad/live/#" title="Run it live, as a page of this server" aria-label="Run this example as a page of this server"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-zap" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13.5 2.5L5 13.5h6.5l-1 8 8.5-11h-6.5Z"/></svg></a><pre><code style="color: #000000">&lt;p&gt;<b>{<font color="blue">scores</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>player</font>}</b> has <b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>points</font>}</b>. <b>{/<font color="blue">scores</font><font color="red"></font>}</b>&lt;/p&gt;<br><b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>tsv</font>}</b></code></pre></td>
        
        
          <td style="vertical-align:top">
  <p>Ann has 21. Bob has 17. </p>
<pre>player	points
Ann	21
Bob	17
</pre>


</td>
        
      </tr>

    

  
    </table>
  






<ul>
  <li>The formats are the files of <code>pad/subs/formats/types/</code> - toml, ini, tsv,
      ndjson, jsonseq (JSON text sequences), markdown, ics, vcf, geojson, gpx, vtt, srt, xlsx
      and json, csv, yaml, xml; rss, atom and jsonfeed write only. An extension names its format too: md, jsonl, yml.</li>
  <li>A text a format cannot read is an error naming the format and the line -
      <code>TOML error on line 3: the key 'name' is defined twice</code>; with the strict check
      off it gives no rows.</li>
  <li>TOML, INI, GeoJSON and GPX are never guessed - they read as CSV, JSON or XML before -
      so name them, or keep them in a file with their extension.</li>
  <li>Writing data out - a calendar, a feed, a spreadsheet - is <a href="/pad/manual/?pages/feeds_and_exports">Feeds and exports</a>.</li>
</ul>
